author: TheMightyTRexUK

example.text: Lights on in Kitchen and Lounge

added: **Pairing on your home network:** give the bridge's address, or choose one found on the network, then press its link button. Nothing goes to the Hue cloud.
**Lights three ways:** by room, by zone and by device type, each light with on and off, brightness, and a colour or a white named in words.
**A switch for every light** in a room, a zone, a type or the whole home, and the brightness and colour of them all at once.
**Scenes:** each room's and zone's scenes, to show one or turn the room off.
**Schedules in words,** such as Every weekday at 07:00, Kitchen to 80%, with sunrise and sunset. Kept on the bridge, so they run while the plug-in rests.
**When something plays:** a scene of your choice when someone starts playing something in Jellyfin, after sunset if you like.
**Dashboard cards:** your rooms with their lights, and which rooms have lights on. Buttons to turn every light off or on.

description: Your Hue lights by room, zone and type: on and off, brightness, colour, scenes and schedules, through the Hue bridge on your home network. Nothing goes to the Hue cloud.
name: Philips Hue

settings.hint: Pair with the Hue bridge on your home network: give its address or choose one found, then press its link button.
settings.label: Bridge

settings.hint: Each room's lights: activate or deactivate them, dim them and give them a colour or a white.
settings.label: Rooms

settings.hint: The same lights by the zones you made in the Hue app, such as Downstairs.
settings.label: Zones

settings.hint: The same lights by what they are: bulbs, light strips, lamps and the rest.
settings.label: Device types

settings.hint: Each room's and zone's scenes, to show one.
settings.label: Scenes

settings.hint: Timed actions in words, such as Every weekday at 07:00, Kitchen to 80%. They are kept on the bridge.
settings.label: Schedules

settings.hint: A scene to run when someone starts playing something in Jellyfin.
settings.label: Scene when something plays

settings.hint: Runs the scene only when it is dark outside, as your bridge works it out. Needs your location set in the Hue app; without it, the scene runs at any time.
settings.label: Only after sunset

settings.hint: Jellyfin's names for apps, such as Jellyfin Web or Jellyfin Android TV, one a line. Leave it empty for any app.
settings.label: Only when playing in these apps
